title: Developer Launchpad: Sample App & Quickstart Recipe Matrix
creator: Ethan Park
description:
Purpose: Deliver a cohesive "Quickstart Recipe Matrix" and a curated Sample App Library that reduces time-to-first-success for engineers evaluating or integrating Redwood Inference. This initiative builds language-and-use-case specific recipes (e.g., Node streaming chat, Python embeddings search, Java demo for model rollouts) plus opinionated repo templates, CI checks, and telemetry hooks wired into Console activation metrics.

Why now: Trials show most new teams stall at wiring up streaming + tool-calling in their first 48 hours. A structured set of sample apps + copyable recipes will increase activation, reduce support load, and standardize evaluation fidelity across SDKs and deployments.

Scope: 1) Recipe matrix mapping 6 SDK languages to 10 canonical use cases with step-by-step manifests and runtime guidance; 2) 8 production-like sample app repos with CI templates and cost/perf knobs; 3) Console integrations: prebuilt dashboards and event tags for sample-app telemetry; 4) Developer checklist and a one-click repo bootstrap flow in the Console.

Out of scope: full localization, paid training, and enterprise-only private deployment automation (those will be separate follow-ups).
goals: 1) Reduce median time-to-first-success (first valid response) from sign-up to sample-run by 60% for new trials. 2) Increase sample-app driven signup-to-active-key conversion by 25%. 3) Achieve 80% of sample repos passing CI checks and linting in first merge. 4) Surface three actionable DX insights from prebuilt telemetry within 30 days of launch.

acceptance_criteria: Recipe matrix published in docs with examples for all supported SDK languages
At least 6 sample repos published under org with CI passing and README checklists
Console shows events from sample apps in staging account and dashboard templates importable by customers
Playbook reduces manual support requests for first-run issues by at least 30% in pilot cohort
risks: SDK breaking changes during iteration requiring recipe updates
Sample apps accidentally using non-representative usage patterns (too optimized)
Telemetry event mismatch between SDK and Console event contracts
Resource contention with runtime optimization sprints
mitigations: Lock SDK surface for the cycle and run compatibility smoke tests
Peer review checklist to ensure sample apps use realistic config defaults
Define clear event contract with SDK and Console teams and add contract tests
Coordinate milestone calendars with infra leads and deprioritize lower-impact work if needed
notes: Pilot cohort: invite 10 customers from SMB segment with varying stacks; collect session replays and short interviews. Plan a lightweight post-launch review 14 days after public beta to iterate on top 3 friction points. Coordinate with growth for a small gated email drip to surface the one-click sample bootstrap.
